name: Jesters
description: The Jesters were a predominantly Irish gang from Washington Heights in Manhattan, active in the 1950s. They became widely known after the July 1957 murder of 15-year-old Michael Farmer at Highbridge Pool, when members of the Egyptian Kings and Dragons attacked Farmer and a companion, believing them to be Jesters. The killing helped inspire public awareness of New York City gang violence and is often associated with the cultural backdrop of West Side Story.
